items.title: How much does a concrete debrief actually change recovery time?
items.description: L3's Path A (specific, scheduled recovery steps) and Path B (a vague 'great work, let's move on') started from the same three-week crunch and ended up on very different capacity curves. Drag "How brutal the crunch was" to set the starting severity, then drag "How concrete the debrief is" from Path B's vague end toward Path A's specific end, and watch the estimated weeks until the team's capacity is actually restored.

params.name: crunchIntensity
params.label: How brutal the crunch was (incidents, overnight pages, duration)

params.name: debriefConcreteness
params.label: How concrete the debrief is (vague "take it easy" vs. specific, scheduled steps)

items.compute: const severity = params.crunchIntensity / 100; const concreteness = params.debriefConcreteness / 100; const weeks = 2 + severity * 10 * (1 - concreteness * 0.85); return { weeks: Math.round(weeks * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Weeks until capacity is actually restored
